datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: Table values without a schema slot, preserved here: ZZT = 5.0 ohm max at IZT = 45 mA; IZM (admissible zener current) = 170 mA (p. 2). This datasheet publishes no ZZK/IZK knee impedance columns.
In forward_voltage_points the current entry is the exact specified test condition (source_kind 'typical'); the voltage entry is a maximum rating.
Additional ratings on p. 1: PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC, RthJA = 375 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC.
Manufacturer footer full name: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).
extraction.omission_reason: The only figures in this datasheet are Fig. 1 Power Derating Curve and Fig. 2 Typical Transient Thermal Impedance (p. 3), both thermal ratings. It contains no zener I-V, forward I-V, leakage, or capacitance characteristic plot, so there is no electrically usable curve to digitize for this part.
